df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
key=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
# for each row, find its nearest earlier row in same key group
import numpy as np
disagree=0; pairs=[]
for _,grp in df.groupby(key, sort=False):
    if len(grp)<2: continue
    rows=grp.reset_index()
    for i in range(1,len(rows)):
        for j in range(i):
            d=abs(rows.bmi[i]-rows.bmi[j]); p=abs(rows.diabetes_pedigree[i]-rows.diabetes_pedigree[j])
            pairs.append((rows['index'][j],rows['index'][i],d,p,rows.outcome[i]!=rows.outcome[j]))

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
key=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
keep=[]
for _,grp in df.groupby(key, sort=False):
    kept=[]
    for idx,row in grp.iterrows():
        if not any(abs(row.bmi-df.at[k,'bmi'])<=0.5 and abs(row.diabetes_pedigree-df.at[k,'diabetes_pedigree'])<=0.01 for k in kept):
            kept.append(idx)
    keep+=kept
clean=df.loc[sorted(keep)].reset_index(drop=True)
print(clean.shape, clean.outcome.mean().round(3))
tr,te=train_test_split(clean,test_size=0.2,random_state=42,stratify=clean.outcome)
tr.to_csv('train.csv',index=False); te.to_csv('test.csv',index=False)
print(tr.shape, te.shape, tr.outcome.mean().round(3), te.outcome.mean().round(3))
"
